name: Stereo Skyline
description:
'''Stereo Skyline''' was an American [[pop rock]] band from [[East Meadow, New York]], which was formed in 2006. The band's most successful line-up consisted of guitarist and lead vocalist [[Kevin Bard]], drummer Rob Michelsen, bassist Brian Maddox and lead guitarist Clayton Johnson.

The group signed with [[Columbia Records]] in 2009, and has played at [[The Bamboozle#2007|The Bamboozle 2007]], [[The Bamboozle Left 2009]], [[The Bamboozle 2009]], [[Take Action Tour#The 2010 Tour|The 2010 Take Action Tour]], [[The Bamboozle#The Bamboozle Roadshow 2010|The Bamboozle Roadshow 2010]]. Their discography consists of two [[Extended play|EPs]] and two albums, ''[[Stuck On Repeat (album)|Stuck On Repeat]]'' and ''The Good Life'', the first peaked at number 133 on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]].
